_comment: Someone else's field record: a notebook already holding pages. Purely derived words by default —
block and biome names are what a naturalist catalogues in bulk, while the authored vocabulary
stays something you find one page at a time. Set derived_only to false to mix them. Never an uncommon or
rare word (Jonah, 2026-10-21): drawn evenly from every derived word, a notebook named a rare one in most
finds, and a page stands in for writing its word, so it was an Age of diamonds a few libraries in.
